start.title: [TODO:es] A Father Had Two Sons
start.text:
[TODO:es] Jesus sits on the hillside.
"A father had two sons. Listen."

turn_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Stay Awhile
turn_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Some stories find you anyway.
Sit back down.

inheritance.title: [TODO:es] Give Me My Share
inheritance.text:
[TODO:es] "Father, give me my inheritance now."
The father divides his wealth.

praise_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Look Closer
praise_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He treats the gift as a wage.
Feel what the father feels.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Love Lets Go
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] The father will not force him.
Love gives freedom, even painful.

leaving.title: [TODO:es] Far From Home
leaving.text:
[TODO:es] The young son packs his bag.
He walks the road away from home.

cheer_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Not Yet
cheer_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Freedom without love grows cold.
Watch carefully.

revelry.title: [TODO:es] Wild Living
revelry.text:
[TODO:es] In a far country he spent it all
on feasts, friends, and folly.

envy_consequence.title: [TODO:es] It Will Fade
envy_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Pleasure without love is hollow.
Wait and watch.

lookaway_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Stay With Him
lookaway_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Mercy does not turn away.
Keep your gaze on him.

famine.title: [TODO:es] Famine Falls
famine.text:
[TODO:es] His money is gone. Famine comes.
His friends have all vanished.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Have Mercy
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He is breaking. Do not laugh.
Feel his hunger with him.

pigs.title: [TODO:es] Among the Pigs
pigs.text:
[TODO:es] He feeds pigs to survive.
He longs to eat their husks.

pity_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Look Deeper
pity_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] His soul is starting to wake.
Watch what happens inside.

repentance.title: [TODO:es] I Will Arise
repentance.text:
[TODO:es] "I will go to my father.
I have sinned. I am not worthy."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You do not know that father.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk the road home with him

hidden_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Come Home
hidden_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Shame keeps you in the mud.
Repentance rises and walks.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk the road home with him

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Trust the Father
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] His love is greater than your fall.
Go, and see.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk the road home with him

return.title: [TODO:es] While He Was Far Off
return.text:
[TODO:es] The father sees him from afar.
He runs, and falls on his neck.

stern_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Behold the Father
stern_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He does not wait for the speech.
He runs. He kisses. He weeps.

feast.title: [TODO:es] Bring the Best Robe
feast.text:
[TODO:es] "My son was lost and is found!
Bring the robe. Begin the feast!"

prove_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Grace, Not Wages
prove_consequence.text:
Él ya era un hijo.
El amor restaura antes de pedir.

brother.title: El hermano mayor
brother.text:
El hermano mayor está en el campo.
«¿Él recibe un festín? ¡Yo te serví!»

agree_consequence.title: Más amplio que eso
agree_consequence.text:
Lo que a la soberbia le parece injusto
es pura alegría para el amor.

hide_consequence.title: Habla con sinceridad
hide_consequence.text:
El padre también sale a tu encuentro.
No escondas tu corazón.

ending.title: Teníamos que celebrar
ending.text:
«Hijo, todo lo que tengo es tuyo.
Pero él estaba perdido y ha sido hallado».
